cohort: 20,230 neonates admitted to the pediatric unit of Sheikh Zayed Hospital, Rahim Yar Khan, out of 76,800 total patients (aged 0-14 years) admitted over a 5-year period.
finding: Birth asphyxia, low birth weight, prematurity, sepsis, and congenital malformation are the main causes of neonatal admission and mortality.
mod_finding: 64% of neonates were delivered by spontaneous vaginal delivery, while 36% were cesarean born; of the neonates who died, 39% were delivered at home, 36% in Sheikh Zayed Hospital, and 25% in private clinics and hospitals.
birth_weight: Low birth weight accounted for 53% of total admissions; 61% of expired neonates were low birth weight.
